To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
PEG was found to be effective for chain transfer reaction catalyized by various PHA synthases.
the PHA synthase from Alcaligenes eutrophus was the most effective in PEG-mediated CT reaction, and the PEG-induced molecular weight of P(3HB)s was dependent on the molecular weight of PEG.

the PHA synthases catalyzed the chain transfer reaction of PEG with the carboxyl group of P(3HB), and the PEG-induced CT reactions resulted in a reduction of molecular weight of P(3 HB) and a change of the end group structure of P(3hb).
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of PHA synthesis technology for producing PHA copolymers by using PHA synthases and CT agents.
the effects of various PHA synthases on CT reaction in E.coli.
the effects of P(3HB)-synthase on P(3HB)/PEG CT reaction in E.coli.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the reactivity of a PHA synthase with PEG is determined by the amino acid residues at the active sites of PHA synthase.
PEG is an effective exogenously added CT agent to PHAs, and that PEG-induced CT is a common phenomenon in PHA biosynthesis.
the reactivity of the PHA synthases toward PEG is in the order of PhaC1 > PhaC2 > PhaC3 > PhaC4 > PhaC5 > PhaC6.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the CT reaction of PHA synthase is not a simple process and that the reactivity of each PHA synthase toward PEG as a CT agent differs significantly.
the PHA synthases of E. coli can be classified into two groups based on their CT reaction activity with PEG as an exogenous CT agent.

PEG-induced CT reactions by PHA synthases were observed in the presence of exogenous CT agents, and the reactivity of the PHA synthases was in the order of PhaC1_PhaC2_PhaC3_PhaC4_PhaC5_PhaC6, and the reactivities were independent of the PHA monomer compositions of the synthesized P(3H) polymers.
The main takeaway from our work is that
PEG-induced CT reactions are highly dependent on the types of PHA synthase used in PHA synthesis.
the PEG-induced CT reactions can be used as an effective method for reducing P(3HB)s molecular weight.
PHA synthases have the potential to be applied in the development of novel polymer materials by using CT reaction.
